hypotheses.primary: Factor history length, salient B position and return dynamics independently to identify which change causes Native causal-action transfer failure, with the exact same held-out factual source identities in each factorial cell.
hypotheses.secondary: A learned position-invariant B-measurement reader can transfer to longer histories and shifted salient positions more reliably than the original recurrent history gate while retaining causal B and fifth-measurement necessity.
hypotheses.native_specific: A genuine Native-backbone component must improve the learned reader over fully trained and information-matched conventional memory controls, not merely carry a successful common readout.

source.generator: Fresh source-neutral action-consequence worlds using the R42 selected-fifth probe and physical return laws, but independent R43 salts and group IDs; NO original F7 or external authentic first-use.

factorial_eval.B_signal: One signed 0.24*hidden_gate marker, noise for other steps; append extra nuisance observations for 16-step history without moving marker.
factorial_eval.state_and_q_constant: Return states 0.61/0.73 by even/odd group; q-magnitude exactly 1.0 in every factor cell.

return_laws.quartic: Frozen R42 selected-return quartic action physics
return_laws.cubic: Frozen R41 cubic selected-return OOD physics

factorial_eval.source_pair_rule: For each group/public context/q/gate, generate paired alternative physics outcomes by separately actually selected returns, never provide unchosen return outcome or evaluator metadata to any learner.
factorial_eval.negative: Random/unregistered panel or group, source panel metadata, hidden q/gate, evaluator-only marker position, withheld return effect and future target must not reach learners.
factorial_eval.data_reuse: Fresh R43 FIT and frozen factorial EVAL are single-use source-neutral DEV; no post-score panel/seed/label tuning; R42 scores remain consumed and immutable.

methods.shared_pretrained_binder: Replay verified original R38 binder on original qualified factual FIT solely as fixed reference for each R43 neural arm; report actual replay update cost; freeze its parameters.
methods.salience_reader: Shared per-observation trainable MLP score on (selected action-key,selected B effect), masked softmax over all B history rows, pooled value features, then learned scalar gate. No absolute-max oracle, no generated marker index, no panel tags, no future effects, no hand-coded gate label.
methods.native_fusion: Native salience arm receives the original R34 native backbone's pre-action feature in addition to the learned salience reader; zero-backbone ablation must alter held-out actions. History-only salience uses exactly the same B reader without Native.
methods.trainable_parameters: Measure all trainable and frozen parameters, actual AdamW steps, total CPU wall time, and any unmatched compute; equal updates alone is NOT equal compute.

budget.init_seed_offsets: Arm-specific deterministic offset from each original 985201/985207 seed

controls: B swap in matched gate-flip pairs
observable factual positive-control reading selected history only
methods.conventional_controls: Original recurrent Native/history-only plus independently trained GRU and SSM, all with identical FIT data and 256 updates per arm; no conventional baseline preselected by EVAL.
methods.benchmarking: Report complete training, replay, scoring, calibration, original baseline and test runtime; strict matched compute is UNVERIFIED unless demonstrated.

factorial_diagnostics.length_effect: Paired mean regret (len16 - len8) holding marker family and return law constant
factorial_diagnostics.position_effect: Paired mean regret (novel - seen) holding history length and return law constant
factorial_diagnostics.physics_effect: Paired mean regret (cubic - quartic) holding history length and marker family constant
factorial_diagnostics.significant_pairing: Paired group bootstrap 10,000 resamples, seed 21769999, 95% interval excluding zero; report all cells without choosing favorable contrasts
factorial_diagnostics.interaction_rule: If multiple main effects/interactions occur, do not attribute cause to a single factor; no post-result panel deletion.

native_incremental.floor_rule: A zero-regret conventional control rules out positive regret superiority; mark Native incremental threshold FAIL, not workaround.

prospective_decision.engineering_qualification: After implementation and frozen score run, mandatory exact-source G4 full Windows+Ubuntu, G5 Windows+Ubuntu, G7 pinned Mamba2 Ubuntu, original artifacts and reproducible cross-OS action-vector comparison. Do not shorten regression.
prospective_decision.scientific_classification: All R43 results are synthetic development only. Independent original-world, sealed fresh first-use, GPU and broad retention/scientific acceptance remain separate and UNVERIFIED.
prospective_decision.stop_rules: If either original seed fails frozen causal salience or conventional gain threshold, preserve NO-GO. No extra seeds, retuned laws, post-result loss changes or rerun on consumed scores.
